html: II. עצה (√ of foll.; meaning dub.; cf. Sab. עצֿם wood DHMZMG xxxvii (1883), 341, 412, Arabic غِضَةٌ, orig. عِضَهَةٌ nom. unit. of عِضَاهٌ large, thorny trees (v. Lane; also NöGGA 1862, 544; ZMG xxxii (1878), 406 LagBN 158 f.); Ethiopic ዕፅ tree, wood; Assyrian iṣ(ṣ)u; Ph. עץ wood; NH = BH; Aramaic אָע (init. א by dissim.); BaNB § 2, c. 1 thinks originally bilit.)
